Cómo canjear los códigos de Free Fire
Los jugadores de Free Fire y Free Fire MAX pueden canjear códigos promocionales para obtener objetos sin costo, como aspectos, cajas de armas, trajes, emotes, oro u otros artículos disponibles dentro del juego. El procedimiento debe realizarse desde el sitio oficial de recompensas de Garena y no desde la aplicación.
Para reclamar un código, el primer paso es ingresar al portal Rewards Redemption Site desde un navegador. Allí, el usuario debe iniciar sesión con la misma cuenta que utiliza en el juego, vinculada a servicios como Google, Facebook, Apple, Huawei, VK o X, según las opciones habilitadas en cada región.
Las cuentas de invitado no pueden completar el canje. Antes de ingresar un código, los jugadores que usen ese tipo de perfil deberán asociarlo a uno de los métodos de acceso compatibles. Una vez vinculada la cuenta, el premio se acreditará en ese mismo perfil y no podrá enviarse a otro usuario.
Cómo ingresar los códigos y recibir las recompensas
Después de iniciar sesión, el jugador debe copiar o escribir el código alfanumérico en el campo de canje y confirmar la operación en el portal de canje de Garena.
Es importante revisar cada carácter antes de enviarlo: una letra o un número incorrecto impedirá que el sistema valide la solicitud. Conviene evitar espacios al principio o al final de la secuencia.
Si el código continúa vigente, tiene cupos disponibles y funciona en la región de la cuenta, el portal mostrará un mensaje de confirmación. Cada clave se puede utilizar una sola vez por usuario y puede dejar de funcionar si alcanzó el límite de canjes, expiró o fue distribuida para otro servidor.
Tras la validación, las recompensas llegarán al buzón interno de Free Fire. La entrega puede ser inmediata, aunque Garena contempla un plazo de hasta 24 horas.
Para comprobarla, el usuario debe abrir el juego con la cuenta vinculada y revisar el apartado de correo. Se recomienda utilizar únicamente el portal oficial, ya que las páginas o aplicaciones que prometen códigos, diamantes o generadores gratuitos pueden poner en riesgo las credenciales de acceso.
Para qué sirven los códigos de Free Fire
Los códigos de Free Fire sirven para obtener recompensas dentro del juego sin gastar diamantes ni dinero real. Cada combinación puede habilitar objetos distintos, como aspectos para armas, trajes, emotes, cajas, oro o artículos temporales para personalizar la experiencia.
Estos códigos no garantizan un premio específico: su contenido depende de la clave publicada y de las condiciones de la promoción.
Además, pueden tener vigencia limitada, un número máximo de usos o restricciones regionales. Por eso, un código válido en un servidor puede no funcionar en otro, y una clave puede quedar inutilizada luego de alcanzar su cupo de canjes.
El beneficio se acredita en la cuenta con la que se realizó el canje y, en general, llega al buzón interno del videojuego.
Para recibirlo, el jugador debe ingresar la secuencia en el portal oficial de recompensas con un perfil vinculado, ya que las cuentas de invitado no pueden utilizar esta función.
Conviene copiar cada código sin espacios ni errores y reclamarlo cuanto antes: los códigos expiran o agotan sus cupos y no pueden usarse más de una vez por cuenta. Las recompensas varían según la campaña activa de Garena.

articles.title: Apple Unveils New iMac with M6, Delivering a Major Boost in Performance and AI Capabilities
articles.text:
Tuesday, October 27th 2026
Apple Unveils New iMac with M6, Delivering a Major Boost in Performance and AI Capabilities
Apple today announced the new iMac featuring the superfast M6, delivering even more performance and powerful AI capabilities in its strikingly thin all-in-one design. From families and aspiring creators to small businesses, users will experience the speed and power of M6 in everything they do. Featuring a faster CPU and GPU with Neural Accelerators in each core, it blazes through everyday apps and multitasking while delivering powerful performance for creative workflows like photo and video editing. For Intel-based upgraders, the leap is even greater, with up to 18x faster performance than the most popular Intel-based iMac. And together with the Dual 16-core Neural Engine, the new iMac delivers up to 5x faster on-device AI performance than M4.1 Whether users are taking advantage of Siri AI and Apple Intelligence features across apps and macOS, running local AI models, or vibe coding, iMac is a powerful platform for AI while preserving user privacy. 
Connectivity gets even better with Wi-Fi 7 and Bluetooth 6, along with available 2.5 Gigabit Ethernet and storage that is up to 2x faster, so apps and large projects launch in an instant. Completing the iMac experience is an expansive 24-inch 4.5K Retina display; an industry-leading camera, speakers, and mics; up to four Thunderbolt 4 ports; color-matched accessories; and the power of macOS 27. Available in a spectrum of seven colors—blue, green, pink, yellow, purple, orange, and silver—the new iMac is a tremendous upgrade for existing users and an incredible gateway into everything the Mac can do for new users. Customers can pre-order starting tomorrow, October 28, with availability beginning Friday, November 6.
Shelly Goldberg, Apple's vice president of Hardware Engineering"iMac is the world's best all-in-one, and today it raises the bar yet again," "With the blazing performance and AI capabilities of M6 supercharging every workflow and the next generation of Apple Intelligence with Siri AI—combined with its stunning 24-inch Retina display, its gorgeous design in seven vibrant colors, and macOS 27—the new iMac has everything users need to run their businesses, manage their lives, and bring their ideas to life."
iMac with M6: A Huge Leap in Performance and AI Capabilities
With M6, iMac brings even more performance, for everything from everyday productivity to creative workloads and AI tasks. iMac with M6 features up to a 12-core CPU—two more cores than before—delivering the world's fastest single-threaded CPU performance. Everything feels extra snappy and responsive for families managing busy calendars, students putting the finishing touches on a project, and small business owners running their companies. An up-to-12-core GPU, also with two more cores than before, now features Neural Accelerators in each core, delivering up to 2x faster graphics for more intensive tasks like photo editing, along with fantastic gaming performance compared to M4.3 Students and creators can now fly through tasks like editing and sharing their latest videos or designing a project for class, all while multitasking with their favorite messaging or entertainment apps. The new Dual 16-core Neural Engine delivers up to 2x faster AI compute than the previous generation, and combined with the advanced GPU and faster memory bandwidth and with higher memory bandwidth up to 170 GB/s, iMac rips through AI tasks like running LLMs on device. With all this performance packed into its stunning design, iMac is the perfect all-in-one for a wide range of users and workflows.
The new iMac with M6 enables:
- Up to 2.5x faster performance in apps like Microsoft Excel, compared to iMac with M1, and up to 1.5x faster performance than M4, so families, aspiring creators, and small businesses can fly through daily productivity tasks.
- Up to 3.3x faster graphics performance for tasks including photo editing in Affinity, compared to iMac with M1, and up to 2x faster performance than M4, so content creators can edit like never before.
- Up to 12x faster on-device AI performance for prompt processing in LM Studio, compared to iMac with M1, and up to 5x faster performance than M4, so users can run powerful AI models, all while keeping their data private.
- Up to 2x higher gaming performance with ray tracing compared to M4.
iMac with M6: A Powerful Platform for AI
Beyond delivering exceptional performance for everyday productivity and creative workflows, iMac is also a powerful platform for AI, enabling users to take advantage of advanced AI capabilities while protecting their privacy. With macOS 27, the next generation of Apple Intelligence is deeply personal, seamlessly integrated across apps, and built with privacy from the ground up. Apple Intelligence powers Siri AI, a new version of Siri that is profoundly more capable, conversational, and personal, helping users get more done than ever before. On iMac, users can tap into Siri AI to ask questions; find what they need across their messages, emails, photos, and more; and take action across apps. Siri AI is built right into Spotlight, making it easy to search for answers on virtually any topic and ask follow-up questions. With the expansive 24-inch 4.5K Retina display, users can leverage Visual Intelligence with a dedicated keyboard shortcut to ask Siri about anything on their screen, from a chart in a spreadsheet to a photo in a browser tab. Users can also write and edit with Siri almost anywhere they type, and in Mail and Messages, Siri can reflect their typical style and tone.
Apple Intelligence also makes apps smarter and more useful. In Safari, it powers new tools that automatically organize a user's tabs into topics; notifies them of website changes, like product restocks or price drops; and enables the creation of custom extensions based on a description. In addition, users can easily create an automation in Shortcuts by simply describing it or tap into intelligent photo editing tools in the Photos app. iMac also supports a growing ecosystem of AI apps optimized for Apple silicon, including LM Studio Bionic and Topaz Studio, helping users learn faster, think in new ways, and get more done.
Best-in-Class Connectivity and Faster Storage
The new iMac features Wi-Fi 7 and Bluetooth 6, along with 2.5 Gb Ethernet that delivers up to 2.5x faster wired connectivity than the previous generation. This means faster transfers of large files, smoother streaming of high-resolution content, and even better performance for gaming and demanding business workflows. And with up to 2x faster SSD read and write performance, apps launch quickly, and large files like photo libraries and video projects load in an instant.
Up to four Thunderbolt 4 ports enable superfast data transfers and make it easy to connect a wide range of accessories, including external storage and docks. Users can also connect up to two 6K external displays, creating a vast workspace with more than 50 million pixels to spread out their work.
A Transformational Upgrade
The new iMac is a tremendous upgrade—especially for users coming from an Intel-based iMac, who will experience performance that's up to 18x faster. And with macOS 27, Siri AI and new Apple Intelligence features integrated across apps make AI tasks on iMac more personal and powerful than ever.
iMac also includes all of the popular features and capabilities that make it the world's best all-in-one:
- A beautiful canvas for work and play: iMac provides a brilliant canvas for multitasking, immersive movies and games, and more. The stunning 4.5K display delivers crisp, clear details with 500 nits of brightness—offering 5x more resolution and nearly 70 percent greater brightness than the bestselling 24-inch all-in-one PC. And P3 wide color brings everything onscreen to life with over 1 billion colors.
- Industry-leading camera and audio: A 12MP Center Stage camera helps keep users perfectly framed on video calls, while Desk View enables them to share a top-down view of their workspace—ideal for educators giving lessons or creatives showing off their latest project. iMac also brings incredible audio to any space. Two pairs of force-cancelling woofers with two tweeters fill the room with bold, bass-rich sound, and Spatial Audio with support for Dolby Atmos creates an immersive listening experience. Completing the phenomenal video and audio experience is the studio-quality three-microphone array.
- A colorful addition to any space: iMac transforms any space with a spectrum of seven vibrant colors, adding a pop of inspiration to homes, workspaces, and storefronts.
- Color-matched accessories and Touch ID: iMac features a color-matched keyboard and mouse or trackpad with USB-C ports, so users can charge all of their favorite devices with just a single cable. Magic Mouse and Magic Trackpad make navigation easy and intuitive. And Magic Keyboard with Touch ID lets users easily and securely unlock iMac, switch users, authorize Apple Pay, and download apps.
- Better together with iPhone: iMac brings everything users love from iPhone to a gorgeous, spacious display. When both devices are used together with Continuity, they are even more powerful—letting users move seamlessly across devices to share files and photos, hand off tasks, and even control their iPhone from their iMac. Users switching to Mac for the first time can use iPhone to conveniently and securely transfer settings, files, photos, passwords, and more
.
macOS 27 Golden Gate: An Unrivaled Experience
The new iMac comes to life with macOS 27. In addition to Siri AI and Apple Intelligence, iMac gets even more responsive, reliable, and delightful for everyday use with refinements to design, performance, search, and more. Updates to Liquid Glass deliver a more focused and approachable experience. A new slider in Settings gives users the option to personalize Liquid Glass, adjusting it anywhere from ultraclear to fully tinted to match their preference, and app icons are sharper and more defined.
iMac and the Environment
The new iMac was built with the environment in mind and drives progress toward Apple's ambitious plan to be carbon neutral across its entire footprint by 2030. It is made with 100 percent recycled aluminium in the stand, 100 percent recycled rare earth elements in all magnets, and 100 percent recycled gold plating and tin solder in all Apple-designed printed circuit boards. It is manufactured with 40 percent renewable electricity, such as wind and solar, across the supply chain. The new iMac meets Apple's high standards for energy efficiency and safe chemistry. As with all Apple products, its paper packaging is 100 percent fiber-based and designed to be recycled.
Pricing and Availability
- Customers can pre-order the new iMac with M6 starting tomorrow, October 28, on apple.com/store and in the Apple Store app in 35 countries and regions, including the U.S. It will begin arriving to customers, and in Apple Store locations and Apple Authorized Resellers, starting Friday, November 6.
- iMac with M6 featuring a 10-core CPU and 10-core GPU starts at $1,499 (U.S.) and $1,449 (U.S.) with education savings. iMac with a 12-core CPU and 12-core GPU starts at $1,699 (U.S.) and $1,599 (U.S.) with education savings. articles.title: Microsoft Authenticator tem falha grave; correção já foi liberada • Tecnoblog
articles.text:
Microsoft Authenticator tem falha grave; correção já foi liberada
Vulnerabilidade no Microsoft Authenticator para Android permite que invasores obtenham credenciais de autenticação do usuário.
Se você usa o Microsoft Authenticator para Android, certifique-se de ter a versão mais recente do aplicativo instalada em seu dispositivo. Isso porque a versão atualizada corrige uma vulnerabilidade grave no app que, como tal, pode permitir que um invasor obtenha credenciais de autenticação em vários serviços.
O problema foi descoberto pela empresa de segurança digital Enclave e recebeu a pontuação 8,6 (de 10) na escala de gravidade CVSS 3.1. Isso significa que a vulnerabilidade é realmente muito séria.
De acordo com a Enclave, um invasor pode explorar a falha fazendo um aplicativo para Android, mesmo que não tenha privilégios ou permissões especiais, se passe por um app oficial da própria Microsoft, de modo a induzir o Authenticator a repassar a ele tokens de autenticação correspondentes.
A partir daí, os tokens de autenticação podem ser usados para permitir que o invasor tenha acesso a contas do usuário em vários serviços. A Enclave afirma que, em seus testes, conseguiu acessar contas de e-mail, agenda e arquivos confidenciais explorando a vulnerabilidade.
A Enclave comunicou a vulnerabilidade à Microsoft prontamente. Esta, por sua vez, reconheceu o problema por meio do registro CVE-2026-80097, publicado em 8 de setembro de 2026. Os detalhes técnicos da descoberta foram divulgados pela Enclave só recentemente, porém.
Para ficar livre do problema, instale a versão 6.2606.4246 ou posterior do Microsoft Authenticator. Para checar a versão instalada em seu celular ou tablet Android, basta acessar a página do Microsoft Authenticator na Google Play Store.
O Microsoft Authenticator é um aplicativo disponível para Android e iOS que permite ao usuário realizar autenticação em duas etapas em numerosos serviços.
A ferramenta também pode ser usada para gerar códigos de verificação temporária para logins, bem como para permitir que determinados serviços da Microsoft sejam acessados sem digitação de senha.

articles.title: "Esto es alucinantemente loco": Hemos tenido que cambiar de nuevo el eje de las ordenadas para poder mantener a El Niño de 2026 dentro
articles.text:
Ese amasijo de líneas azules que hay más arriba es un resumen visual, corto y al pie, de los últimos 45 años de temperaturas del Pacífico ecuatorial. Ese es el contexto, pero la historia es otra cosa: la línea roja. Es decir, las cifras de lo que va de 2026.
Eso y que, por primera vez, tenemos que ampliar el eje hasta los cuatro grados de anomalía para que no se salga por arriba.
¿Qué es exactamente El Niño? No está de más recordar que nos referimos a un fenómeno climático cíclico (aunque muy irregular) que tiene grandes efectos sobre el clima mundial. Enormes, de hecho. Si excluimos a las estaciones, se trata de la fuente más importante de variabilidad climática anual de todo el planeta.
Durante la fase cálida (es decir, durante El Niño), la ausencia de unos vientos alíseos fuertes que refresquen la superficie del Pacífico ecuatorial hace que la temperatura de esa zona del océano se dispare. Es esto, a través de diferentes teleconexiones atmosféricas, lo que trastoca todos los sistemas meteorológicos del mundo.
Los efectos son variados y cambian según la región ("condiciones más secas de lo normal en determinadas partes del mundo; mientras que en otras provoca más precipitaciones. Unos países tienen que lidiar con sequías importantes y otros, con lluvias torrenciales", dice AEMET); pero cuando hablamos de temperaturas no hay duda: El Niño es sinónimo de calor.
Así que repasemos los números. Con los datos diarios de la NOAA en la mano, el máximo de El Niño de 2015 fue una anomalía de +3,02 ºC, el 19 de noviembre; el de 1982, +2,78 °C; el del 97, +2,39 °C. El 26 de octubre de 2026 esas mismas aguas marcaban +3,49 °C.
En el fondo, ahí está todo: El Niño de 2026 está casi medio grado por encima del de 2015, más de un grado por encima del de 1997 y, según el consenso de los modelos, todavía no ha tocado techo.
¿Por qué sigue subiendo? Porque es lo normal. Así funciona El Niño. Es decir, en la medida en que hay más agua en el hemisferio sur, son sus estaciones las que marcan la temperatura del agua. Es normal que (en plena primavera austral) la temperatura siga subiendo.
Además, en cierta forma, El Niño se está retroalimentando a sí mismo. En condiciones normales, los alisios funcionan como un ventilador que empuja el agua caliente hacia Indonesia. Cuando el centro y el este del Pacífico ecuatorial ganan temperatura, los vientos pierden fuelle y eso hace que el mismo sistema que enfría esa zona deje de hacerlo.
La cosa es que, a riesgo de repetirme, no es un año normal: los mapas de la NASA dan zonas del Pacífico hasta 40 centímetros más altos de lo normal.
¿Y hasta cuándo? Los récors anteriores suelen fijarse en noviembre. Así que, a priori, nos queda un mes de subidas. La OMM prevé una media de unos +3,7 °C para octubre-diciembre, frente a un récord trimestral previo de +2,6 °C, y su actualización del 21 de octubre eleva a unos +3,8 °C la de noviembre-enero.

articles.title: Pas de pub dans Claude : Anthropic s’y engage...alors que la start-up brûle des milliards de dollars
articles.text:
Le dossier d’introduction en Bourse d’Anthropic, rendu public lundi 26 octobre, contient une lettre signée de ses sept fondateurs, dont le PDG Dario Amodei et sa sœur Daniela, qui préside l’entreprise. Ils y promettent noir sur blanc que Claude, leur assistant IA, restera sans publicité. La déclaration tombe à deux semaines de la tournée des investisseurs, attendue la semaine du 9 novembre.
Du Super Bowl au gendarme boursier
Anthropic promettait déjà cela en février, sur un tout autre support. Le 4 du mois, l’entreprise publiait un billet resté célèbre : « Il existe beaucoup de bons endroits pour la publicité. Une conversation avec Claude n’en fait pas partie ». Quatre jours plus tard, deux spots du Super Bowl, l’un diffusé avant le coup d’envoi, l’autre en plein match, martelaient le slogan « La publicité arrive dans l’IA. Mais pas dans Claude », en réponse directe à OpenAI, qui venait d’ouvrir ChatGPT aux annonceurs.
Dans la lettre jointe au prospectus, les fondateurs reprennent l’argument presque mot pour mot : « Dès que la publicité entre dans les objectifs de revenus d’une entreprise, la pression pour optimiser l’engagement tend à croître ». La seule incitation de Claude, écrivent-ils, doit rester de fournir des réponses utiles. Daniela Amodei allait plus loin en février en jugeant que la publicité exploitait la nature intime des conversations confiées à ces assistants. L’entreprise estimait alors que ce caractère personnel rendrait toute annonce « incongrue », voire inappropriée dans bien des cas.
Là où le tacle de février relevait du marketing opportuniste, la décision inscrite dans le prospectus est d’un tout autre ordre : un document de ce type engage ses signataires devant le régulateur américain et les investisseurs, là où un billet de blog pouvait s’effacer sans bruit. Et ces signataires garderont la main, puisqu’une action de classe F leur réserve 50,1 % des droits de vote après l’opération.
Un pari à 80 milliards de pertes
Le même prospectus chiffre l’addition : 16,3 milliards de dollars de revenus au premier semestre 2026, pour une perte nette de 80,7 milliards de dollars sur la même période, dont 72,4 milliards de charge comptable liée aux levées de fonds. Les revenus ont encore accéléré depuis, à 16,8 milliards sur le seul troisième trimestre. L’opération vise une valorisation autour de 2 000 milliards de dollars, parmi les plus grosses introductions de l’histoire.
Le modèle revendiqué pour tenir sans la manne publicitaire : des contrats avec les entreprises et des abonnements payants, réinvestis dans l’amélioration de Claude. Pendant ce temps, OpenAI, xAI et Google avancent tous vers des réponses financées par les annonceurs.
À la veille de l’opération, la promesse sert aussi d’argument commercial, puisqu’elle démarque Claude de ChatGPT auprès des investisseurs comme du grand public. Le document ne consacre d’ailleurs pas une ligne à ce que rapporterait la publicité.

articles.title: Regal debuts Goal Oriented Agents, putting an actor and a director model on every call - SiliconANGLE
articles.text:
Regal debuts Goal Oriented Agents, putting an actor and a director model on every call
Enterprise voice artificial intelligence company Regal Voice Inc. today added Goal Oriented Agents to its platform, enabling businesses using them to define what a call has to accomplish, and providing two AI models that split the work of getting there.
The new agents are aimed at a problem Regal says shows up in calls such as auto insurance claims, in which someone reporting an accident tends to explain what happened, where and who was involved in one go. Agents built on conditional logic often circle back for details the caller already gave, just so each field gets filled. Building the whole agent on a single prompt keeps the conversation open, and in Regal’s view it leaves business processes only loosely followed.
Goal Oriented Agents put two models on each call. Regal calls them an actor and a director, and both start work as soon as the caller stops talking. The actor, a smaller and faster model tuned for dialogue, replies right away. Running behind it, the director checks whether the goals for the current stage have been met and can move the call to a new stage with fresh instructions for the actor.
Businesses build the agents out of goal nodes, each listing the goals to be met by the end of the node and any prerequisites that come first. Booking a callback can count as one of those goals. A prerequisite is something the agent has to establish before it can act, such as the caller’s date of birth. Regal said those can be written as plain-language conditions too, for example “the caller mentioned a death in the family.”
The director reviews progress after every turn, so one answer can tick off several items at once. Regal’s sample auto insurance claim has a caller named Dan describing the vehicle damage, photo evidence and injuries in his first message. All three get marked as collected, and the agent goes straight to his name. Once it has that, the director sees location and policy number are still missing, so the actor’s next question is where he is.
Regal said complex intake and qualification calls are among the strongest uses it has seen for the agents. The company named Medicare enrollment, roadside assistance and mortgage qualification as uses the design opens up. Medical intake that complies with the Health Insurance Portability and Accountability Act is another.
Google LLC, AAA and Toyota Motor Corp. are among the more than 200 enterprises Regal says it serves. Customers of Five9 Inc.’s contact center platform gained access to Regal’s voice agents through an integration in August.
Regal is a venture capital-backed startup that has raised $83 million to date. That includes a $40 million round in October 2024.

articles.title: Plus de 400€ de réduction pour le Samsung Galaxy S26 noté 9/10 par la rédaction !
articles.text:
Pointé du doigt pour son prix à sa sortie, le Samsung Galaxy S26 gomme enfin ce défaut grâce à AliExpress où il perd plus de 400 euros sur son prix d’origine, mais conserve ses qualités comme son écran de 6,3 pouces lumineux.
Alors que les rumeurs autour du Samsung Galaxy S27 enflent de plus en plus, le Samsung Galaxy S26 n’a pas encore dit son dernier mot. Sur AliExpress, il passe sous les 600 euros. À ce prix, le smartphone sud-coréen devient un excellent appareil qui brille par sa polyvalence tant sur la partie photo que sur ses performances.
Au lieu de 999 euros, le Samsung Galaxy S26 chute à 590,17 euros sur AliExpress dans sa version de 256 Go
Pourquoi choisir le Samsung Galaxy S26 ?
- Pour les trois appareils photo : Rien de nouveau sous le soleil puisque Samsung ressort la configuration du Galaxy S25. Cependant, le rendu reste convaincant de jour comme de nuit grâce à un bel apport de l'IA.
- Une continuité appréciable : Si Samsung ne s’est pas mouillé avec son Galaxy S26, le choix de la continuité peut avoir du bon puisque l’écran reste lumineux tandis que l’interface est toujours intuitive. Seul bémol : les performances qui sont bridées pour empêcher la chauffe.
- Enfin au bon rapport qualité prix : Vendu pour 999 euros à sa sortie, le Samsung Galaxy S26 peinait à être attractif tant les différences avec le S25 étaient minimes. Désormais bradé à moins de 600 euros, le Samsung Galaxy S26 est enfin vendu à un prix qui lui correspond.
On prend les mêmes et on recommence
Sans surprise, Samsung n’a pas révolutionné le design de sa gamme pour son Galaxy S26. Le dos reste plat avec les coins toujours arrondis. Seule petite différence, l’écran qui prend 0,1 pouce et l’épaisseur qui augmente de 1 mm. Même constat sur l’appareil photo avec une configuration identique à celle présente sur le Samsung Galaxy S25. Le trio de capteurs signe son retour avec un grand angle de 50 MPx, un téléobjectif x3 de 10 MPx et un ultra grand-angle de 12 MPx.
Pour bonifier vos clichés, vous pourrez compter sur l’intelligence artificielle. L’IA pourra notamment améliorer vos clichés la nuit. Parmi ses autres fonctionnalités, l’intelligence artificielle propose un clavier intelligent pour vous offrir des raccourcis personnalisés ou une gomme audio pour isoler votre voix lorsque vous vous enregistrez.
L'écran est donc légèrement plus grand avec 6,3 pouces, mais la luminosité reste la même avec 2 600 nits et un taux de rafraîchissement de 120 Hz.
Un prix attractif pour effacer certains oublis
Pour rester sur l’écran, le Samsung Galaxy S26 ne profite pas de la nouvelle technologie de Samsung : le Privacy Display, exclusive à la version Ultra. Celle-ci permet de mettre un filtre de confidentialité sur votre écran pour éviter que les plus curieux ne regardent ce que vous faites sur votre smartphone. Cette absence n’est pas gênante pour un produit vendu pour moins de 600 euros.
Ce qui est plus dérangeant en revanche, ce sont les performances. Le Samsung Galaxy S26 est porté par l’Exynos 2600 qui peine à rivaliser avec le Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 5. Surtout, ce processeur est bridé par Samsung pour éviter la chauffe de l’appareil. Par conséquent, sur les jeux les plus gourmands comme Fortnite, il faudra faire l’impasse sur les meilleurs graphismes.
✅ Les points forts
- Une expérience bonifiée par l’intelligence artificielle
- Un écran de 6,3 pouces toujours lumineux
- Toujours polyvalent en photo
❌ Les limites
- Un smartphone qui n’est pas à la pointe de la technologie de Samsung
- Toujours pas de chargeur fourni
Sur AliExpress, le Samsung Galaxy S26 est vendu pour 590,17 euros au lieu de 999 euros
Au moment de sa sortie, le Samsung Galaxy S26 était vendu pour près de 1 000 euros. Une augmentation qui s’explique par l’inflation des différents composants comme celui de la RAM. Depuis, le prix a baissé, rendant le smartphone plus attractif malgré ses défauts. Désormais disponible pour moins de 600 euros, il s’offre enfin un rapport qualité-prix intéressant.

articles.title: “La vida es corta para andar con gente sin recursos”: el criterio de Jeff Bezos para armar equipos de éxito
articles.text:
“La vida es corta para andar con gente sin recursos” resume una de las ideas asociadas a Jeff Bezos sobre la formación de equipos de trabajo. El fundador de Amazon convirtió una librería online creada en 1994 en una compañía con presencia en comercio electrónico, logística, entretenimiento y computación en la nube.
Detrás de ese recorrido hubo decisiones empresariales arriesgadas, pero también una visión sobre las personas que deben participar en un proyecto.
La frase no se refiere necesariamente al dinero, los contactos o la formación académica. En este caso, contar con recursos significa tener la capacidad de responder ante un problema, buscar alternativas y avanzar cuando faltan herramientas, información o experiencia previa.
Para los equipos de tecnología y negocios, esa actitud puede marcar la diferencia entre una dificultad que bloquea el trabajo y una oportunidad para corregir el rumbo.
Jeff Bezos y la importancia de las personas resolutivas
El planteamiento atribuido a Jeff Bezos pone el foco en una cualidad concreta: la iniciativa. Una persona resolutiva identifica un obstáculo y trata de encontrar una salida. Puede aprender una habilidad, solicitar ayuda, revisar procesos o proponer una alternativa sin esperar de forma permanente una indicación externa.
Desde esa perspectiva, el valor de un profesional no depende solo de los conocimientos que acumula al comenzar un empleo. También cuenta su reacción ante tareas desconocidas, problemas inesperados y cambios de prioridades.
En sectores que evolucionan con rapidez, esta capacidad resulta útil porque los equipos deben tomar decisiones antes de contar con todas las certezas.
En una organización, esta actitud también reduce la dependencia de decisiones jerárquicas para asuntos cotidianos. Los responsables pueden concentrarse en las cuestiones estratégicas si los equipos tienen margen para resolver incidencias operativas con criterio y comunicación.
La eficiencia como complemento de la iniciativa
El texto de referencia sobre Bill Gates, cocreador de Microsoft, aporta una idea relacionada con esta visión. La frase “Elijo a una persona perezosa para hacer un trabajo difícil. Porque una persona perezosa encontrará una manera fácil de hacerlo” suele interpretarse como una defensa de la eficiencia.
La expresión no plantea una exaltación de la falta de esfuerzo. El sentido se relaciona con quienes rechazan tareas innecesarias y buscan simplificar procedimientos. Una persona con ese enfoque puede automatizar procesos repetitivos, eliminar pasos que no aportan valor o encontrar una forma más directa de completar un trabajo complejo.
La productividad no se mide únicamente por la cantidad de horas dedicadas a una tarea, sino por la capacidad de obtener resultados con menos pasos y menos recursos. En ámbitos como el desarrollo de software, la logística, la consultoría o la atención al cliente, esa mentalidad permite detectar demoras y prevenir cuellos de botella.
La conexión entre ambas ideas está en la respuesta ante los problemas. Bezos destaca la necesidad de contar con personas capaces de moverse frente a la incertidumbre. Gates, según el sentido de la frase, resalta el valor de quienes buscan una vía más sencilla y eficiente para completar una tarea difícil.
La formación de equipos exige iniciativa y colaboración
Un equipo sólido no se compone de personas que intentan resolverlo todo de manera individual. Requiere perfiles capaces de actuar, pero también de compartir información, aceptar correcciones y reconocer los límites de sus conocimientos.
La iniciativa sin comunicación puede provocar errores. La búsqueda de eficiencia sin atención a los detalles puede eliminar controles necesarios. Por eso, el criterio para formar equipos no debería reducirse a la rapidez o a la autonomía, sino incluir la responsabilidad con la que cada persona aplica esas habilidades.
En entornos tecnológicos, donde los cambios son frecuentes, la capacidad de aprender y resolver conserva un valor central. La frase atribuida a Bezos funciona como una síntesis de esa exigencia: trabajar con personas que no se paralicen ante los problemas y que sepan convertir una dificultad en un siguiente paso.

articles.title: 7 of the biggest iOS 27.2 upgrades — from Siri improvements to the new Apple Music icon
articles.text:
iOS 27.2 has landed with a wealth of updates — these are the 7 biggest changes, including Siri improvements and a new Apple Music icon
New features, looks, and layouts
- iOS 27.2 is rolling out now
- The update includes a new Apple Music icon, new languages and features for Siri, and adds suggestions to the Messages app
- It also brings Dual Capture to group FaceTime calls, plus various other changes
iOS 27.2 is now rolling out, and while this update isn’t as big as iOS 27 itself was, there’s quite a lot here to get stuck into, so — even putting aside the inevitable bug fixes — it’s well worth downloading.
Highlights include various improvements to Siri, such as the ability for Siri to draw on more personal context sources, including voicemails, photos attached to messages, and calendar event attendees. This update also brings more languages to Siri AI, including French, Japanese, Korean, Portuguese, and Spanish.
Some other AI features have also been improved, with, for example, SynthID labeling now being added to Image Playground creations and substantially edited photos, such as those that have had the Reframe or Extend tools used on them. This means that it will be harder for people to pass off AI images as real ones.
Updates to Apple Music, Messages, and more
Away from AI, iOS 27.2 also brings a new icon to Apple Music, with this one being black and white rather than red — bringing it more in line with the company’s other recent iconography.
There are also now suggestions in the Messages app, which are tappable shortcuts that appear based on context. So, for example, if someone invites you to an event, it might prompt you to add it to your calendar.
Plus, Dual Capture is now available in group FaceTime calls, allowing you to show content on both your front and rear cameras simultaneously, and the iPhone Duo has received a couple of updates, adding support for the USB-C Apple Pencil and an Edge Light to brighten your face in video calls.
Those are arguably the seven biggest updates in iOS 27.2, but there are numerous smaller changes too, such as tweaks to the layout of the Podcasts app and an anniversary reminder on phone calls. So there’s a lot here.

articles.title: Google Docs agora edita arquivos Markdown nativamente • Tecnoblog
articles.text:
Google Docs agora edita arquivos Markdown nativamente
Arquivos continuam no formato original e ganham colaboração em tempo real e histórico de versões.
O Google Docs agora aceita arquivos Markdown (.md e .markdown) diretamente, sem que seja preciso transformá-los em documentos no formato próprio do serviço. Com a novidade, é possível trabalhar em um arquivo pelo editor do Google, compartilhá-lo e adicionar comentários mantendo a extensão original.
Markdown é um formato de texto que utiliza caracteres simples para representar elementos como títulos, listas, links e trechos em negrito. Por depender de texto puro, ele é comum em documentação de software, repositórios de código e, mais recentemente, em arquivos utilizados por sistemas de inteligência artificial.
O Google Docs já oferecia algumas ferramentas para trabalhar com Markdown. Desde 2024, era possível importar um arquivo .md, convertê-lo em um documento do Google e depois exportá-lo novamente em Markdown. A diferença agora é que não há conversão.
Ao enviar um arquivo para o Drive e abri-lo no Docs, ele continua armazenado no formato original. O editor passa apenas a mostrar uma versão formatada do conteúdo, como um documento comum, e permite alterá-lo usando a interface tradicional do Docs.
Com o suporte, toda a estrutura de compartilhamento e outras ferramentas da interface do editor de textos pode ser usada nos documentos .md. Os arquivos podem ser editados simultaneamente por diversos usuários sem que seja necessário escrever a sintaxe do Markdown.
O histórico de versões também fica disponível, o que pode ser útil caso alguma formatação não compatível seja alterada durante a edição. Importante notar, inclusive, que nem todos os recursos visuais do Docs podem ser preservados no formato.
Cores de fonte, destaques e alinhamento de texto são removidos, enquanto chips inteligentes podem virar texto comum ou links. Conteúdo em HTML também pode ser transformado em texto simples.
A mudança também chegou à pré-visualização do Google Drive. Ao abrir um arquivo Markdown, o usuário pode alternar entre o conteúdo original e uma versão renderizada. Nela, elementos como títulos, tabelas e links clicáveis aparecem já formatados.
Antes, um arquivo Markdown precisava virar um documento do Docs para ser editado normalmente, processo que podia alterar a formatação e separar o arquivo original de sua versão colaborativa.
O suporte nativo não exige ativação nas configurações e está disponível tanto para todos os clientes do Google Workspace quanto para usuários de contas pessoais do Google.

articles.title: Apple Introduces the New 14-inch MacBook Pro with M6
articles.text:
Tuesday, October 27th 2026
Apple Introduces the New 14-inch MacBook Pro with M6
Apple today announced the new 14-inch MacBook Pro with M6, delivering even more performance, powerful on-device AI capabilities, and faster connectivity for college students, business users, creators, and more. M6 features an advanced 12-core CPU with the world's fastest CPU core, so everything from productivity tasks to more demanding pro workflows feels incredibly fast and responsive. The 12-core GPU delivers up to 30 percent faster graphics and up to 25 percent faster AI workloads when compared to M5, making the 14-inch MacBook Pro with M6 a compelling value for users who need serious power. 
For those upgrading from M1, the performance gains are even more significant, with up to 11x faster graphics and up to 13x faster AI performance. With additional Neural Accelerators in the GPU and a Dual 16-core Neural Engine, M6 turns MacBook Pro into an even more powerful platform for AI—from taking advantage of Siri AI and Apple Intelligence features across apps and macOS to running LLMs locally, all while preserving user privacy. In addition, the 14-inch MacBook Pro features Wi-Fi 7 and Bluetooth 6, while superfast storage makes working with large files, exporting projects, and running demanding AI workflows fly. And with phenomenal battery life of up to 24 hours, it delivers the same remarkable performance whether plugged in or on battery, so users can work, create, and pursue their passions from anywhere.It also offers the advanced features users love, including the stunning Liquid Retina XDR display with a nano-texture option, a 12MP Center Stage camera, an immersive six-speaker sound system, and a wide array of ports. Together with macOS 27, the new 14-inch MacBook Pro with M6 is a major upgrade for existing Mac users and those coming to Mac for the first time. Available in space black and silver, it can be pre-ordered beginning tomorrow, October 28, with availability starting Friday, November 6.
Shelly Goldberg, Apple's vice president of Hardware Engineering"The 14-inch MacBook Pro is the pro laptop of choice for a wide range of users—from college students, to business professionals across every industry, to multidisciplinary creators doing it all on one device," "With the powerful M6 chip, we're taking performance to the next level, with a boost in CPU speed and graphics and even more powerful capabilities for on-device AI. With its amazing battery life, remarkable Liquid Retina XDR display, and even faster connectivity, the new 14-inch MacBook Pro with M6 delivers a fantastic combination of performance, capability, and value."
M6: Blazing-Fast Performance and On-Device AI Capabilities
M6 brings even more performance and next-level AI capabilities to the 14-inch MacBook Pro. Featuring a powerful 12-core CPU, a 12-core GPU with Neural Accelerators in each core, Dual 16-core Neural Engine, and faster unified memory, MacBook Pro with M6 is faster and more responsive.
The 12-core CPU, with two more cores than before, brings blazing-fast single- and multithreaded performance, so users can fly through everything from multitasking across apps to compiling code to handling complex creative workflows. The 12-core GPU, also with two additional cores, delivers up to 30 percent faster graphics performance when compared to M5.2 Everything from 3D modeling to photo editing and gaming feels incredibly fast, enhanced by a third-generation ray tracing engine and Dynamic Caching to optimize on-chip memory. 
It also brings up to 25 percent faster performance for on-device AI workloads, like LLM prompt processing, compared to M5.3 The Dual 16-core Neural Engine delivers up to 1.9x faster performance than M5 and works with the advanced GPU to dramatically accelerate AI workloads like image generation, Super Resolution, and AI upscaling. The Neural Engine also powers Apple Intelligence, enabling advanced and energy-efficient on-device AI processing. The 14-inch MacBook Pro with M6 does all this with industry-leading performance per watt and up to 24 hours of battery life, the longest ever in a Mac. With 16 GB of unified memory standard, configurable up to 32 GB, and higher memory bandwidth up to 170 GB/s, MacBook Pro makes multitasking and working with demanding apps and large projects even faster.
The 14-inch MacBook Pro with M6 enables:
- Up to 13x faster time to first token performance for LLM prompt processing compared to the 13-inch MacBook Pro with M1, and up to 1.3x faster than the 14-inch MacBook Pro with M5.
- Up to 11.7x faster render performance with ray tracing in Blender compared to the 13-inch MacBook Pro with M1, and up to 1.3x faster than the 14-inch MacBook Pro with M5.
- Up to 3.3x faster image-processing performance in Affinity compared to the 13-inch MacBook Pro with M1, and up to 1.2x faster than the 14-inch MacBook Pro with M5.
- Up to 2.5x faster project build performance when compiling code in Xcode compared to the 13-inch MacBook Pro with M1, and up to 1.3x faster than the 14-inch MacBook Pro with M5.
A Huge Upgrade with Even More Value
There's never been a better time for customers to upgrade from a previous-generation MacBook Pro with Apple silicon or an Intel-based Mac. The 14-inch MacBook Pro with M6 delivers remarkable value thanks to major performance improvements and powerful AI capabilities. The new 14-inch MacBook Pro also features all of the compelling capabilities that have made it so popular, including:
- Phenomenal battery life: In addition to the huge leap in performance, battery life gets up to 14 additional hours for Intel-based upgraders and up to four more hours for users coming from M1, delivering up to 24 hours overall, so users can get more done on a single charge. Users coming from Intel-based and M1 systems will also get 16 GB of starting unified memory, an additional Thunderbolt port, and the space black finish with an anodization seal for fewer fingerprints.
- A brilliant pro display: The stunning Liquid Retina XDR display delivers up to 1600 nits of peak HDR brightness and a 1,000,000:1 contrast ratio, bringing HDR photos and videos to life with deep blacks, brilliant highlights, and vibrant colors. And for users working in bright or challenging lighting conditions, a nano-texture display option dramatically reduces reflections and glare.
- Powerful connectivity: Now with Wi-Fi 7 and Bluetooth 6, the 14-inch MacBook Pro delivers fast wireless performance and low latency, along with support for up to two external displays. Its versatile array of ports—including the HDMI, MagSafe 3, and three Thunderbolt 4 ports; an SDXC card slot; and a headphone jack—makes it easy to connect high-speed peripherals, transfer photos, or expand a workspace.
- Advanced camera, mics, and speakers: A 12MP Center Stage camera with Desk View helps keep users perfectly framed on video calls, while a studio-quality three-mic array and amazing six-speaker sound system with Spatial Audio deliver an immersive audio experience.
- Fast charging: MacBook Pro with M6 supports fast charging, reaching up to 50 percent charge in just 30 minutes when paired with a compatible higher-wattage USB-C power adapter, such as the 96 W Power Adapter.
- A laptop that's built to last: With an enclosure made from 100 percent recycled aluminium, MacBook Pro is exceptionally durable and can stand up to everyday use for years to come.
- Better together with iPhone: When used together with Continuity, iPhone and Mac are even more powerful—letting users move seamlessly across devices to share files and photos, hand off tasks, and even control their iPhone from their 14-inch MacBook Pro. Users switching to Mac for the first time can use iPhone to conveniently and securely transfer settings, files, photos, passwords, and more.
macOS 27 Golden Gate
The new 14-inch MacBook Pro with M6 comes to life with macOS 27, which includes Siri AI, a profoundly more capable, conversational, and personal assistant; helpful Apple Intelligence features across everyday apps; and improvements that make the Mac even more responsive and reliable. Siri AI can draw on personal context to help users find what they need in the moment across messages, emails, photos, and more; answer questions about virtually any topic; and get things done across apps—all with groundbreaking privacy protections. Siri AI is integrated into Spotlight and systemwide context menus, and users can ask Siri about what's on their display with Visual Intelligence using a dedicated keyboard shortcut. Users can also write and edit with Siri almost anywhere they type.
Additionally, Apple Intelligence makes apps smarter and more useful. In Safari, it powers new tools that automatically organize a user's tabs into topics; notify them of website changes, like product restocks or price drops; and enable the creation of custom extensions based on a description. Users can also easily create an automation in Shortcuts by simply describing it, or tap into intelligent photo editing tools in the Photos app. The new 14-inch MacBook Pro gets even more responsive, reliable, and delightful with refinements to design, performance, search, and more. Updates to Liquid Glass deliver an even more focused and approachable experience. A new slider in Settings gives users the option to personalize Liquid Glass, adjusting it anywhere from ultraclear to fully tinted to match their preference, and app icons are sharper and more defined.
14-inch MacBook Pro with M6 and the Environment
The new 14-inch MacBook Pro with M6 was built with the environment in mind and drives progress toward Apple's ambitious plan to be carbon neutral across its entire footprint by 2030. It is made with 45 percent recycled content overall, including 100 percent recycled aluminium in the enclosure, 100 percent recycled cobalt in the battery, and, in a first for Apple, 100 percent recycled tantalum in multiple capacitors. It is manufactured with 60 percent renewable electricity, such as wind and solar, across the supply chain. The 14-inch MacBook Pro with M6 is designed to be durable and repairable, and meets Apple's high standards for energy efficiency and safe chemistry. As with all Apple products, its paper packaging is 100 percent fiber-based and designed to be recycled.
Pricing and Availability
- Customers can pre-order the new 14-inch MacBook Pro with M6 starting tomorrow, October 28, on apple.com/store and in the Apple Store app in 35 countries and regions, including the U.S. It will begin arriving to customers, and in Apple Store locations and Apple Authorized Resellers, starting Friday, November 6.
- The 14-inch MacBook Pro with M6 starts at $1,999 (U.S.) and $1,899 (U.S.) with education savings. Additional technical specifications and configure-to-order options are available at apple.com/macbook-pro.

articles.title: Hyphenate bags $45M in funding to accelerate autonomous financial operations - SiliconANGLE
articles.text:
Hyphenate bags $45M in funding to accelerate autonomous financial operations
A startup called Hyphenate says it’s quickly helping enterprises to overcome their fear of artificial intelligence hallucinations and trust it to fully automate their financial operations after raising $45 million in early-stage funding today.
The Series A round was led by Nexus Venture Partners and saw participation from B Capital and existing backers Foundation Capital, BoldCap and Gaia Ventures, bringing the startup’s total amount raised to date to $54 million.
Hyphenate, officially known as Prosperous Commerce Inc., has built an autonomous finance platform that uses self-learning AI agents. Those agents are designed to familiarize themselves with businesses’ financial operations so that they can take over the work of the traditional chief financial officer, performing tasks such as general ledger accounting, treasury management, order-to-cash, procure-to-pay and financial reporting. Its agents integrate with companies’ existing enterprise resource planning, accounting and banking systems to avoid the need for expensive software overhauls.
The startup, which was previously called Maximor until it rebranded earlier this month, is led by co-founder and Chief Executive Ramnandan Krishnamurthy (pictured, right, alongside co-founder Ajay Krishna Amudan), who concedes that corporate finance has always been extremely challenging for AI to get a handle on. Because of unforgiving regulatory requirements and financial reporting standards, few CFOs have been willing to tolerate the risk of AI agents that could potentially hallucinate and mess up vital calculations regarding their finances.
In a recent study, Hyphenate highlighted the widespread apprehension of CFOs regarding AI. Though 96% of survey respondents identified alleviating the burden of repetitive and manual tasks as one of AI’s major benefits, only 14% said they actually trust the technology to do that without making mistakes. Moreover, 97% of CFOs insisted that human supervision of AI work is essential.
However, Hyphenate believes it can overcome this apprehensiveness by changing the way AI agents learn and execute their work. Rather than asking human financial experts to create prompts and design rule-based workflows for agents, the startup trains them on customer’s historical financial workflows.
By looking at thousands of spreadsheets, email trails, financial records, invoices and so on that date back years, its agents aim to capture what Krishnamurthy calls the “tribal knowledge” of each company’s financial department.. That enables them to understand the peculiarities of their operations.
Moreover, Hyphenate also creates a detailed record of its agents’ work, so that every autonomous action they make is preserved, building an evidentiary paper trail that can easily be audited if the need arises. Should a human financial officer handle an exception, the agents will remember that decision as a kind of precedent, so that they can follow that example with their future work. This is backed by unambiguous operational guardrails and a requirement for human oversight at key moments, when qualitative judgment is required, Krishnamurthy said.
“Every finance team has a long list of work it does because somebody has to do it,” Krishnamurthy said. “Our customers are watching that list shrink in production. Once a team sees the system handle one workflow to an auditor’s standard, they hand it the next one.”
In other words, Krishnamurthy says, customers generally test Hyphenate’s AI agents with one or two financial tasks, see that they do the job perfectly, and start to trust it more. They then give it much greater responsibilities. It’s a pattern that has been repeated at multiple early adapters, Krishnamurthy said, enabling the startup to grow its customer base by 11 times and its revenue by 86 times in the last year, though it didn’t provide more specifics.
Hyphenate says it currently counts six publicly traded companies as customers, including Groupon Inc., Synthesia Ltd., HiBid and Mini Melts USA Inc. Those clients have eliminated up to 90% of their routine manual financial work, while reducing audit exceptions by an average of 75%.
One of its most eager adopters is HiBid, which has used Hyphenate to process more than $2.5 billion in gross merchandise value so far, while reducing the time it spends on month-end closing from three weeks to a day. Nexus Venture Partners’ Abhishek Sharma said Hyphenate’s success so far is due to its laser focus on accuracy, controls and auditability. “Hyphenate has built around that bar from the beginning and the expansion we are seeing inside customer deployments shows what becomes possible once the system earns the right to take on more work,” he said.
Given its early traction, Hyphenate now has much bigger ambitions, setting its sights on automating strategic financial operations for its customers. It believes it can provide continuous visibility into a company’s financial health, enabling more precise forecasting and capital allocation.

articles.title: Hay un motivo por el que los combates de 'Phantom Blade: Zero' parecen una película de artes marciales: Jackie Chan
articles.text:
Cuando vimos por primera vez 'Phantom Blade: Zero' en el PlayStation Showcase de mayo de 2023, muchos pensaron que aquellos combates tan rápidos y espectaculares parecían secuencias de una película de acción. No era casualidad. El proyecto del estudio chino S-GAME lleva años desarrollándose con una idea muy concreta: trasladar al videojuego la precisión, las acrobacias y la contundencia del cine de artes marciales y qué mejor referencia que el propio Jackie Chan. El resultado ha convencido a la crítica y está a punto de llegar al mercado: se estrena el 29 de octubre para PC y PlayStation 5.
El sello de Jackie Chan. Como detallaron nuestros compañeros de 3DJuegos tras viajar a China, detrás de los combates del juego no hay simples trucos de animación, también está el estudio de captura de movimiento Flying Goat en Shanghái, que cuenta con acróbatas experimentados y la certificación del mismísimo Jackie Chan.
En 1976, Jackie Chan creó su propio equipo de especialistas, el Jackie Chan Stunt Team, con el que desarrolló algunas de las coreografías más reconocibles de su carrera. El actor convirtió las acrobacias y los combates en una de sus señas de identidad, una tradición que ha perdurado y está presente en el nuevo juego de S-GAME.
Cables y sensores al milímetro. El rodaje en el plató combina la destreza física de los acróbatas con la tecnología necesaria para capturar tanto los movimientos corporales como las armas de combate. Para reproducir las acrobacias aéreas más espectaculares cuentan con un sistema de cables, poleas y contrapesos instalados en el techo. La tecnología captura todos los movimientos y permite trasladar esa interpretación física a los personajes digitales, logrando un efecto mucho más natural que con sólo animación tradicional.
China juega en primera división. Aunque S-GAME enseñó el proyecto en 2023, en realidad llevaba desde 2018 en marcha. Uno de los motivos de que se haya demorado tanto es precisamente la ambición de los combates con especialistas reales. A eso se suma el diseño de escenarios, enemigos y jefes, con un nivel de producción propio de un triple A.
'Black Myth: Wukong' ya demostró el potencial internacional de una superproducción desarrollada en China y ahora S-GAME busca hacerse un hueco con una propuesta propia, apoyada en una gran ambición técnica y en las artes marciales chinas como seña de identidad.
Las críticas están por las nubes. Cuentan en Vidaextra que las primeras reseñas de 'Phantom Blade: Zero' están siendo excelentes. El juego ya ha cosechado un 88 de 100 en Metacritic y apunta a convertirse en un éxito de ventas. Estará disponible para PC y PlayStation el próximo 29 de octubre.

articles.title: Ce cadre affiche vos photos sans rétroéclairage et tient trois ans sans recharge
articles.text:
SwitchBot AI Art Frame 2 : le cadre à encre électronique voit plus grand
L'art sans prise
Après le premier AI Art Frame, SwitchBot décline son cadre connecté en trois tailles, jusqu'à 80 cm. Au programme davantage d'images en mémoire, une galerie intégrée et une autonomie annoncée de trois ans.
Lors de notre prise en main du premier AI Art Frame, nous avions apprécié le rendu proche du papier de son écran E Ink. Son successeur conserve la technologie couleur Spectra 6, sans rétroéclairage : l'image reste tributaire de la lumière ambiante.
SwitchBot AI Art Frame 2
La nouveauté se voit autour de l'image : le passe-partout blanc disparaît pour étendre l'affichage jusqu'au cadre, doté d'une finition bois couleur noyer. Trois diagonales sont proposées : 7,1, 13,3 et 31,5 pouces, soit environ 18, 34 et 80 cm.
De la place au musée
La galerie d'art, encore en développement lors de notre première prise en main, compte désormais 500 œuvres selon SwitchBot. On peut aussi importer ses photos par lots et les envoyer à distance en wifi. La carte microSD de 16 Go fournie peut accueillir environ 5000 images, contre dix stockées localement sur le premier modèle.
Le changement d'image passe par l'application, un bouton arrière ou trois tapotements sur le cadre. Diaporama et programmation automatisent le défilement. Alexa, l'API SwitchBot et Home Assistant figurent également parmi les possibilités de commande. SwitchBot annonce jusqu'à trois ans d'autonomie sur batterie, à raison d'un changement d'image par jour.
AI Studio permet de transformer une photo ou un dessin en peinture ou en croquis, ou de générer une image à partir d'une description, y compris dictée en maintenant un bouton. Le service reste payant après 30 jours d'essai mais le prix n'a pas encore été communiqué.
Il est disponible dès ce 27 octobre sur la boutique SwitchBot et Amazon, à 199,99 € en 7,1 pouces, 429,99 € en 13,3 pouces et 1599,99 € en 31,5 pouces. Le grand format fait donc aussi son effet sur la facture.

articles.title: Nintendo Switch : vos jeux préférés débarquent sur iPhone, Mac et iPad grâce à cet outil
articles.text:
Un projet open source permet de jouer à des titres Nintendo Switch sur iPhone, iPad et Mac sans passer par un émulateur. Il faut toutefois disposer d’un appareil compatible, de ses propres fichiers de jeu et s’armer de patience pour l’installation.
Jouer à Zelda, Mario ou Metroid sur un appareil Apple, sans émulateur traditionnel, ça vous dirait ? C’est ce que propose nxnative, un projet publié sur GitHub par l’utilisateur seedds. Sa page recense déjà plus de 60 jeux Nintendo Switch testés, allant de Super Mario Odyssey à Metroid Dread. Le projet ne fournit aucun jeu et n’a aucun lien avec Big N, les utilisateurs doivent apporter leurs propres fichiers.
Comment les jeux Nintendo Switch tournent sans émulateur sur Apple
La méthode repose notamment sur un point commun entre les appareils Apple récents et la console de Nintendo : leur architecture ARM. Le code des jeux n’a donc pas besoin d’être traduit pour cette architecture. Nxnative remplace certains composants propres à la Switch, notamment son environnement système, et adapte le rendu graphique à Metal, l’interface graphique d’Apple.
Certains titres peuvent même dépasser la fréquence d’affichage proposée sur la console. Avec la mise à jour adéquate, Fire Emblem Engage et les deux derniers jeux The Legend of Zelda , à savoir Breath of the Wild et Tears of the Kingdom, peuvent atteindre 60 images par seconde, contre 30 sur Nintendo Switch.
Mais ce n’est pas tout. Andrew Tsai, vidéaste spécialisé dans le jeu sur Mac, a ainsi fait tourner Monster Hunter Rise à 60 images par seconde de manière stable sur un MacBook Air M1 d’entrée de gamme doté de 8 Go de mémoire vive. Il a également réussi à lancer Unicorn Overlord.
Installation sur iPhone, iPad et Mac : les prérequis à connaître
Soyez d’ores et déjà prévenus : la procédure exige tout de même quelques manipulations. Il faut d’abord disposer des jeux et des clés de déchiffrement extraits de sa propre Nintendo Switch. La compilation s’effectue ensuite sur Mac, dans Xcode, à l’aide d’un script. Cette première étape peut prendre jusqu’à une heure. Il reste alors à installer l’application avec AltStore ou Sideloadly.
Sur iPhone, il faut un modèle 15 Pro ou plus récent sous iOS 26. Sur iPad, la compatibilité commence avec les modèles équipés d’une puce M1, sous iPadOS 26. Les appareils plus anciens ne prennent pas en charge le format de texture utilisé par les jeux. Le jeu en ligne et les fonctionnalités amiibo ne sont d’ailleurs pas disponibles.
Nintendo n’a jamais caché son hostilité envers les projets de ce genre. En 2024, les créateurs de l’émulateur Switch Yuzu ont accepté de verser 2,4 millions de dollars de dommages et intérêts à l’entreprise japonaise. Ryujinx a, lui, disparu peu après une prise de contact de Nintendo. Autant dire que nxnative pourrait lui aussi très prochainement finir dans le viseur du constructeur.
Source : Digital Trends

articles.title: L'iPhone Duo est-il le pliant le plus puissant du marché ? Les mesures du 01lab
articles.text:
Après une première prise en main au bout de 24 h et l’analyse de ses deux écrans, l’iPhone Duo livre ses performances mesurées par le 01lab. Le premier smartphone pliant d’Apple embarque la même puce A20 Pro, gravée en 2 nm, que l’iPhone 18 Pro. Reste à savoir si un format pliant, plus contraignant pour dissiper la chaleur, lui permet d’en tirer le même parti.
La puissance d’un iPhone 18 Pro dans un pliant
Sur Geekbench 6, l’iPhone Duo fait jeu égal avec l’iPhone 18 Pro, avec 4 712 points en monocœur et 12 506 points en multicœur, contre 4 733 et 12 797 points pour son grand frère. L’écart est encore plus mince sur la partie graphique, avec 64 813 points contre 64 792. Face aux autres pliants, la différence est en revanche très nette. Le Galaxy Z Fold 8 plafonne à 3 624 points en monocœur et 10 958 points en multicœur, et sa partie graphique affiche un score plus de deux fois et demie inférieur (24 575 points). Le Pixel 11 Pro Fold et le Honor Magic V6 restent encore plus loin.
AnTuTu 11 nuance ce tableau, même si ce test se prête davantage aux comparaisons entre smartphones Android qu’entre Android et iPhone. L’iPhone Duo y obtient 3 056 304 points, soit 15 % de moins que l’iPhone 18 Pro, et se fait même devancer par le Galaxy Z Fold 8 (3 240 167 points), l’Oppo Find X10 Pro Max restant en tête avec 3 867 430 points avec son Mediatek Dimensity 9600 Pro. L’écart avec l’iPhone 18 Pro se joue surtout sur la partie processeur, où le Duo recule de 28 % (666 323 points contre 924 828), alors que la partie graphique reste proche (1 330 644 points contre 1 420 892). Puisque Geekbench ne montre aucune différence entre les deux iPhone, ce résultat pourrait traduire une gestion de l’énergie plus prudente sur le pliant.
En jeu, l’iPhone Duo reprend largement l’avantage. Sur le test graphique In Vitro 2, en définition 1080p, il atteint 88,6 images par seconde en moyenne, soit environ le double du Galaxy Z Fold 8 (43,1 ips), du Honor Magic V6 (47,6 ips) et de l’Oppo Find X10 Pro Max (46,2 ips).
Une chute marquée sous la charge, mais un plancher élevé
Comme pour chaque smartphone, le 01lab a lancé 20 boucles du stress test 3DMark Wild Life Extreme, qui mesure la capacité d’un appareil à maintenir ses performances graphiques dans la durée. Format pliant oblige, nous l’avons fait deux fois, une première fois iPhone ouvert et une seconde fois iPhone fermé.
Ouvert, l’iPhone Duo démarre à 7 974 points sur sa meilleure boucle, devant tous les pliants Android et l’Oppo Find X10 Pro Max (7 346 points), mais un peu en dessous de l’iPhone 18 Pro (8 410 points). La chute arrive toutefois très vite. Dès la deuxième boucle, soit au bout d’une minute environ, son score recule de 21 %, puis de 30 % à la troisième. Il se stabilise ensuite autour de 5 500 points jusqu’à la fin du test, pour une stabilité de 65,7 %.
Une fois fermé, l’iPhone Duo grimpe plus haut sur la première boucle, à 8 358 points, presque au niveau de l’iPhone 18 Pro, avant un décrochage plus marqué. Après une première chute à la troisième boucle, il ne trouve jamais vraiment de palier et son score continue de s’éroder à partir de la onzième boucle, pour finir à 4 912 points. Sa stabilité tombe alors à 58,8 %, l’iPhone ayant perdu 41 % de sa puissance de départ.
L’iPhone Duo fait donc partie de ces smartphones qui montent très haut avant de brider fortement leurs performances. Ouvert, il le fait d’ailleurs plus brutalement que l’iPhone 18 Pro, qui perd sa puissance de façon progressive sur une douzaine de boucles, mais il se stabilise plus haut. Sa pire boucle (5 237 points) dépasse ainsi celle de l’iPhone 18 Pro (4 999 points), pour une stabilité de 65,7 % contre 59,4 %. Face aux autres pliants, l’écart est encore plus net. Le Galaxy Z Fold 8 tombe à 3 328 points pour une stabilité de 48,8 %. Le Pixel 11 Pro Fold affiche une meilleure stabilité (62,5 %), mais il part de beaucoup moins haut, et sa meilleure boucle (3 442 points) reste inférieure à la pire de l’iPhone Duo.
Une chauffe mieux contenue que chez les autres pliants
Côté chauffe, notre caméra thermique a relevé une température maximale de 42,2 °C à pleine charge processeur, un résultat proche de celui de l’iPhone 18 Pro (41,6 °C) et inférieur à ceux du Galaxy Z Fold 8 (44,3 °C) et du Pixel 11 Pro Fold (43,9 °C). Le Honor Magic V6 grimpe quant à lui jusqu’à 53,1 °C. Les images thermiques montrent aussi comment l’iPhone Duo répartit sa chaleur. Ouvert, elle se concentre presque exclusivement sur la moitié qui abrite le module photo, l’autre moitié restant quasiment froide. Fermé, elle se concentre au centre du dos, avec un maximum relevé de 42,4 °C en fin de test, contre 42 °C ouvert. Une surface d’échange plus réduite qui pourrait expliquer, au moins en partie, la perte de performances plus marquée en position fermée.
Avec l’iPhone Duo, Apple signe donc le pliant le plus performant que nous ayons mesuré, AnTuTu mis à part. Le format se fait en revanche sentir dans la durée, surtout iPhone fermé, où sa stabilité (58,8 %) retombe au niveau de celle de l’iPhone 18 Pro. Même bridé, il reste toutefois devant ses concurrents pliants, eux aussi rattrapés par la chauffe.

articles.title: Crowdsourcing the corporate brain: Closing polanyi’s paradox on the frontline
articles.text:
Crowdsourcing the corporate brain: Closing polanyi’s paradox on the frontline
Frontline AI turns tacit worker knowledge into shared operational intelligence
Polymath Michael Polanyi famously noted, “We can know more than we can tell,” a paradox that’s now showing up and being solved on the warehouse and retail floor.
Frontline workers possess deep, tacit knowledge of how operations run, mastering practical workarounds, managing exceptions and localized efficiencies, and situational problem-solving. This knowledge never makes it into an official manual, yet real-life experience and multiple academic studies say that up to 85% of company knowledge is tacit.
VP for Automation, EMEA at Zebra Technologies.
Because this knowledge relies on muscle memory, experience, ad hoc conversations during lunch and notes, traditional top-down standard operating procedures (SOPs) inherently fail to capture it. Tacit knowledge enables employee competence, autonomy and job satisfaction, but can be unevenly distributed or lead to gatekeeping to the detriment of others. And when experienced or long-serving employees retire or move to a new company, that tacit knowledge is lost.
For years, businesses assumed their SOPs were rock-solid, but the rollout of frontline AI tools, such as AI knowledge agents trained on SOPs and other workforce onboarding and training materials, is bringing long-overlooked knowledge gaps and outdated guidelines to the surface.
Agents are ushering in a quiet evolution in how enterprises capture institutional knowledge and build connected frontline onboarding and training programs. It comes as workplace culture, learning and development take on new urgency with organizations increasingly understanding their importance for workforce AI transformation.
The new knowledge economy
Instead of relying on centralized teams to write SOPs, the new connected frontline knowledge economy is going bottom-up by leveraging AI tools to crowdsource the “corporate brain,” with SOPs acting as the “nervous system” where knowledge is a two-way street.
By empowering the people stacking shelves, processing orders, talking to customers, and running the warehouses to flag inconsistencies, gaps and workarounds, companies are initiating a proactive audit and refresh of their workforce operations data quality.
Sign up to the TechRadar Pro newsletter to get all the top news, opinion, features and guidance your business needs to succeed!
Workers can actively signal knowledge gaps through their interactions with AI assistants, and those tools are routing the signals into dynamic, intelligently automated updates for training programs and SOPs. Workforce and operations leaders are finally able to turn undocumented, implicit frontline expertise into structured, actionable micro-learning, better procedures, and shift from one-off onboarding to ongoing everboarding.
When frontline contributions are recognized and shared, the workforce becomes better equipped to serve today’s highly informed customers, whether they are stepping into a shop or making an online purchase.
As David Autor, an MIT economist and author of a widely cited paper on the Polanyi paradox and employment said, “The tasks that have proved most vexing to automate are those demanding flexibility, judgment, and common sense—skills that we understand only tacitly...tasks that cannot be substituted by computerization are generally complemented by it.”
AI with all the senses
Organizations can and should move beyond text heavy documents and process guidance. Broadly speaking, learning and development departments already adopt a mix of text, images, videos, and group discussion. This approach reflects how we learn and should be the preferred method when it comes to employee onboarding, everboarding, and capturing implicit knowledge.
Modern AI agents are multimodal, meaning they can receive and output intelligence via audio, text, image, and video. A frontline worker should be able to verbally highlight a gap, suggest an update or snap a photo of a shelf with the AI agent comparing it to the visual merchandising planogram and provide step-by-step corrective instructions.
And with smaller models, on-device inference is possible, meaning no data leaves the device or company network. Latency is eliminated, an additional layer of security is added, and workers and customers get the intelligence they need in the moment.
Moving from knowing to doing
The development, implementation, and ongoing guidance agents require cannot be done alone, in the same way that text heavy, top-down SOPs are no longer sufficient. The top-down methods that brought organizations to this point will not sustain them for tomorrow.
According to a report by MIT, businesses that partner with AI providers have an AI success rate of 66% compared to those who prefer internal development alone (33%). The best way to succeed is to move forward with partners who have industry expertise, AI models, agents, and developer building blocks. They can support the design, configuration, onboarding, and management of AI systems in retail, warehouse, and logistics settings.
And AI transformation cannot be done with an “IT alone” mindset. Stanford’s Digital Lab finds that a top factor (43%) for AI success is executive sponsorship that enables a culture of experimentation and permission to fail. AI’s value comes from the algorithms, the technology required to implement, but mostly it comes from rethinking the people and culture component.
Polanyi’s “knowing versus telling” gap has been brought to light and is finally being closed on the frontline. By crowdsourcing the corporate brain, businesses are capturing tacit knowledge and transforming it into customer and worker advantages that make work better every day.

articles.title: Apple iMac 2026 : après deux ans d'absence, le PC tout-en-un revient avec la puce M6... et c'est tout
articles.text:
Apple iMac 2026 : après deux ans d'absence, le PC tout-en-un revient avec la puce M6... et c'est tout
En tandem avec le MacBook Pro en version M6, Apple a aussi annoncé la sortie imminente du nouvel iMac, toujours équipé de la dernière génération de puce Apple Silicon… et du strict minimum côté nouveautés.
Pour ce deuxième jour consécutif d'annonce produit, Apple ressuscite un hardware que l'on pensait presque oublié depuis sa dernière itération en 2024. En plus du MacBook Pro M6, (re)voici donc l'iMac M6, la solution fixe tout-en-un de la Pomme, qui se contente pour cette version 2026 de quelques upgrades internes… Sans pour autant bousculer une formule qui commence vraiment à montrer son âge.
Évolution sans révolution
L'iMac est désormais alimenté par une puce Apple Silicon M6, déjà aperçue dans le Mac Mini le mois dernier, avec jusqu'à 12 cœurs CPU (2 super cœurs, 4 cœurs de performance et 6 cœurs d'efficacité énergétique) et 12 cœurs GPU comprenant chacun des accélérateurs neuronaux pour les tâches d'IA locales. Le fameux Neural Engine, essentiel pour ces dernières, compte 16 cœurs pour une bande passante mémoire de 170 Go/s – contre 120 Go/s pour la puce M5. Logiquement, la firme de Cupertino met en avant les fonctionnalités de sa technologie Apple Intelligence intégrée au sein de son écosystème – et mentionne au passage certaines applications tierces « optimisées pour l'Apple Silicon » d'IA locales comme LM Studio et son itération agentique Bionic.
Apple iMac (M6)
La connectivité, aussi, a été revue à la hausse avec l'arrivée des interfaces Wi-Fi 7 (enfin) et Bluetooth 6. Comble de la modernité, la connectique entre dans l'ère moderne avec un port Ethernet 2,5 Gb sur son adaptateur secteur, et toujours optionnel et réservé aux modèles à 12 cœurs CPU/GPU. Ce qui nous rappelle que le précédent iMac se contentait d'un simple port Gigabit… Les 4 ports Thunderbolt 4 dans sa partie arrière ne connaissent toutefois pas de changement, toujours compatibles avec 2 moniteurs externes jusqu'à 6K.
Et du reste ? Le calme plat. L'écran Retina à résolution 4,5K affiche toujours une diagonale de 24 pouces qui fait un peu tâche en 2026, tandis que la webcam 12 Mp Center Stage, de bonne facture, ne connaît également pas d'amélioration notable. Un truc a néanmoins bien changé, c'est les tarifs : 1 799 € pour sa version M6 à 10 cœurs CPU/GPU et 2 ports Thunderbolt 4 à 16 Go de RAM et 256 Go (!) de stockage. La version M6 à 12 cœurs CPU/GPU vous en coûtera 1 999 € à configuration égale. À titre de comparaison, la configuration de départ de l'iMac 2024, avec sa puce M4 à 8 cœurs, était commercialisée pour 1 499 €.
Les précommandes de l'iMac M6 seront ouvertes à compter de demain, 28 octobre en France et en Europe. La disponibilité en magasin est prévue pour le 6 novembre.
